name: Wheel bolt (lug)
value: 130 Nm (96 lb-ft) — 160 Nm from MY2012 / black bolts
notes: M14×1.5. Silver bolts up to MY2011: 130 Nm (160 Nm also permitted retroactively). Silver bolts from MY2012 and ALL black bolts: 160 Nm (118 lb-ft). Thinly grease thread/shank/under-head (Optimoly TA); do NOT grease the spherical seat. Tighten diagonally.

name: Engine oil drain plug
notes: M18×1.5; always fit a new aluminium sealing ring. Same for M96/M97 (987.1) and 9A1 DFI (987.2).

name: Oil filter cap / housing cover
notes: Cartridge filter cover; replace and grease the O-ring.

name: Spark plug (987.1 M96/M97)
value: New ~30 Nm (22 lb-ft); reused ~26 Nm (19 lb-ft)
notes: The 987.1 manual gives ft-lb only: new 22 lb-ft, reused 19 lb-ft. No anti-seize.

name: Spark plug (987.2 9A1 DFI)
value: New 32 Nm (24 lb-ft) ±2 Nm; reused 25 Nm (19 lb-ft)
notes: DFI plug — clearly higher than the 987.1 value; do not carry the old figure over.

name: Brake caliper mounting bolt (front)
notes: M12×1.5 to the wheel carrier. Always replace the screws after removal. Do not grease (Dacromet finish).

name: Brake caliper mounting bolt (rear)
notes: M12×1.5, same as front. Single-use screws.

name: Brake line union to caliper
notes: M10×1 pressure line to caliper. (Connecting-line union = 12 Nm.)

name: Brake caliper bleeder screw
notes: M10×1 bleeder screw.

name: Brake disc retaining screw
notes: M6, disc to hub; front and rear.

name: Drive-shaft / rear axle hub nut
notes: M22×1.5 tension bolt / hub nut — always fit a new lock nut; do not grease.

name: Drive shaft to transmission flange bolt
notes: M10 (manual & Tiptronic). Do not grease.

name: Manual transmission drain plug
notes: 987.2 (G87/10): 25 Nm. 987.1 varies: base Boxster 19 lb-ft; S / 2.8 L unit 30 lb-ft (~41 Nm). Fit a new sealing ring.

name: Manual transmission filler plug
notes: Same as its drain plug; the 987.1 S unit is 30 lb-ft. New seal.

name: Tiptronic ATF drain plug (987.1)
notes: A87/01 5-speed Tiptronic. Replace the sealing ring. Filler plug = 80 Nm; ATF-pan bolts ≈ 11 Nm (8 lb-ft) in sequence.

name: PDK ATF oil drain plug (987.2)
notes: CG100 7-speed PDK uses a single ATF for gears and wet clutches. Fit a NEW drain plug.

name: PDK ATF filler plug (987.2)
notes: Fill via metering pump until oil emerges, then tighten. ATF-pan bolts = 2.4 Nm in the prescribed sequence.

name: Coolant drain plug
notes: M14×1.5, internal Torx (a/f 8) at the coolant regulator housing. The workshop manual states only "replace the sealing ring" — no tightening torque is given. Snug by hand with a new seal.

name: Engine mount / carrier bolts
notes: Engine carrier to body M10×1.5 = 65 Nm; stud to body M8 = 20 Nm. Do not grease.

name: Transmission mount bolts
notes: Hydraulic mount to trans bracket M12×1.5 = 85 Nm; bracket to gearbox M10×1.5 = 65 Nm; mount to side member M8 = 33 Nm.

name: Anti-roll-bar drop-link nut (front)
notes: M10 suspension to anti-roll bar; follow the 3-stage procedure. Do not grease. The rear drop link uses the same 3-stage ending at 65 Nm.

name: Front strut top mount
notes: Mount to body M8 = 33 Nm; mount to piston rod M14×1.5 = 80 Nm; strut to wheel carrier M12×1.5 = 85 Nm.

name: Front control-arm bolts
notes: To cross/side member M12×1.5 = 120 Nm; to diagonal arm M14×1.5 = 160 Nm; ball-joint to wheel carrier M12×1.5 = 75 Nm. Do not grease.

name: Ignition coil fastening screw
notes: Two M6×25 screws per coil. Label cylinders before removal.

name: Throttle body fastening screws
notes: M6×50 Torx screws. Adaptation required after removal on drive-by-wire cars.

name: Track rod (axial joint) to steering gear
notes: Hydraulic rack — alignment required after tie-rod work.

name: Tie-rod ball joint to wheel carrier
notes: Aluminum tie rod to axial joint = 50 Nm (37 lb-ft).

name: Serpentine-belt tensioner fastening screws
notes: Tensioner to coolant pump (Internal Torx M8). Tensioning-roller bolt = 23 Nm on some layouts.

name: Battery terminal clamp
notes: Attach manually — do not over-tighten. Terminals do not need grease. Follow WM work instructions after reconnecting.

name: Underbody cover screws / nuts
notes: Centre and rear underbody panels — very low torque; use a torque screwdriver.

name: Rear silencer clamp nut
notes: Clamp on rear silencer; always replace seals and lock nuts when removing the silencer.

name: Anti-roll-bar drop-link nut (rear)
notes: Same 3-stage procedure as the front drop link. M10; do not grease.

name: DME control-unit holder nuts
notes: Fastening nuts securing the control unit and holder after programming/replacement.

name: Engine oil approval
notes: A40-approved oils only (HTHS >= 3.5). Applies to both the M96/M97 and the 9A1 DFI engines.

name: Engine oil viscosity
notes: Factory fill is Mobil 1 0W-40. 5W-40 and 5W-50 are also A40-approved alternatives; some owners prefer 5W-50 for hot-climate/track use.

name: Coolant type
notes: Same pink Porsche coolant family used across the 986/987/981. Concentrate P/N 00004330149; Zerex G40 (861526) is an OEM-equivalent. The 'G40' brand name was formalised later — earlier 987.1 fill is the same pink coolant.

name: Brake fluid
notes: Porsche specifies DOT 4. Flush every 2 years regardless of mileage.

name: Manual transmission / transaxle oil
notes: G87 6-speed (and G87/01 5-speed base). The transaxle integrates the differential, so gearbox and diff share this single oil fill on the manual car.

name: Tiptronic S automatic transmission fluid (ATF)
notes: 987.1 Tiptronic S is the ZF 5HP19 5-speed (A5/50). Porsche P/N 000-043-207-00. This is the 987.1 auto; the 987.2 uses PDK instead.

name: PDK gear oil
notes: Factory fill Mobilube PTX Formula A 75W-90. Separate circuit from the PDK clutch/control fluid. 987.2 only. Porsche P/N 00004330549.

name: PDK clutch / control fluid
notes: Porsche P/N 00004330513. This is the clutch/actuation fluid (often mislabeled 'PDK transmission fluid'), distinct from the 75W-90 gear oil. 987.2 only.

name: Power steering fluid
notes: KEY DIFFERENCE vs the 981: the 987 uses HYDRAULIC power steering (a pump + reservoir), so it DOES take fluid. CHF 11S and CHF 202 are interchangeable. Porsche P/N 000-043-206-56.

name: A/C refrigerant type
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: the entire 987 run predates the R1234yf transition. Verify against the engine-bay refrigerant label.

name: Engine oil capacity (2.7 M96, 987.1)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: with filter. Grouped with the 3.4 figure by capacity databases; confirm with the electronic oil-level gauge after fill.

name: Engine oil capacity (3.4 M97, 987.1)
notes: With filter, per the Porsche workshop-manual capacity table for Cayman S (987) F6-3.4L. After a long hot drain owners top up to ~7.8 L (8.25 qt).

name: Engine oil capacity (2.9 9A1, 987.2)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: with filter, DFI MA1.20 engine. From a capacity database; verify with the on-board oil-level gauge.

name: Engine oil capacity (3.4 9A1, 987.2)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: with filter, DFI MA1.21 engine (Cayman S / R). From a capacity database; verify with the on-board oil-level gauge.

name: Coolant total system capacity (manual)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: total system fill, not a drain-and-fill volume. Manual-transmission cars.

name: Coolant total system capacity (Tiptronic)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: total system fill for Tiptronic cars (extra ATF cooler circuit). Verify against the manual.

name: Fuel tank capacity
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: 64 L is quoted consistently across 987.1/987.2 spec sheets. Some references list a 54 L base tank with 64 L as the common fitment — verify against the specific car.

name: Manual gearbox oil capacity (refill)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: G87/20 6-speed refill; fill plug is a 10mm hex on the LH side. Full changes can take ~2.9-3.0 L.

name: Tiptronic ATF capacity
notes: Most of the fluid stays in the torque converter, so a service exchanges only ~3.5 L. 987.1 ZF 5HP19.

name: PDK gear oil capacity (drain & fill)
notes: Service volume of the 75W-90 gear oil (separate from the clutch fluid). 987.2 only.

name: PDK clutch fluid capacity
value: Total ~5.2 L; ~2-2.5 L exchanged per service
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: total system holds ~5.2 L of Pentosin FFL-3 but a service exchanges only ~2-2.5 L and requires PIWIS temperature-controlled fill. 987.2 only.

name: Power steering fluid capacity
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: hydraulic PS system fill (987 has hydraulic, not electric, steering). CHF 11S / CHF 202.

name: Tyre size (17 inch, 987.1 base)
notes: Base Cayman/Boxster entry wheel. Rims 6.5Jx17 ET55 front / 8Jx17 ET40 rear.

name: Tyre size (18 inch, 987.1 base/S)
notes: Standard on Cayman S; optional on base. Rims 8Jx18 ET57 front / 9Jx18 ET43 rear.

name: Tyre size (19 inch, 987.1 base/S)
notes: Optional 19-inch fitment. Rims 8Jx19 ET57 front / 9.5Jx19 ET46 rear.

name: Tyre size (17 inch, 987.2 base)
notes: Base 2.9 entry wheel. Rims 7Jx17 ET55 front / 8.5Jx17 ET40 rear.

name: Tyre size (18 inch, 987.2)
notes: Note the 987.2 18-inch rear is 255 (vs 265 on the 987.1). Rims 8Jx18 ET57 front / 9Jx18 ET43 rear.

name: Tyre size (19 inch, 987.2 S/R)
notes: Standard on Cayman S / R. Rims 8.5Jx19 ET55 front / 10Jx19 ET42 rear.

name: Tyre size (20 inch, 987.2 R / option)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: 20-inch fitment (Cayman R option). Rims 8.5Jx20 front / 10Jx20 rear.

name: Cold tyre pressure (987.1)
value: F 2.0 bar (29 psi) / R 2.5 bar (36 psi)
notes: LOW-CONFIDENCE: database value; the high rear figure is likely the full-load spec — normal-load is lower. 19-inch front is ~2.2 bar (32 psi). ALWAYS defer to the door-jamb / fuel-flap placard for the definitive normal vs full-load figures.

name: Cold tyre pressure (987.2)
notes: LOW-CONFIDENCE: database baseline. ALWAYS defer to the door-jamb / fuel-flap placard for the definitive normal vs full-load figures.

name: Battery type
notes: KEY DIFFERENCE vs the 981: the 987 has NO start-stop, so a standard flooded (SLI) battery is acceptable and was often OEM — AGM is a fine upgrade but not required. Replacement does NOT need PIWIS coding on the 987. Located in the front trunk.

name: Alternator output
notes: OEM Bosch 150 A (P/N 99760302205 / 99760301209). A 180 A unit exists as an upgrade / for high-load option cars.

name: Spark plug type (M96/M97)
notes: OEM plug for the 987.1 M96/M97 engines. Porsche P/N 99917022390. Pre-gapped; do not re-gap the multi-ground design.

name: Spark plug type (9A1 DFI)
notes: OEM plug for the 987.2 DFI 9A1 engines. Porsche P/N 99917013090. Different from the 987.1 plug — do not interchange.

name: Key fob battery
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: standard for the era; confirm the coin cell in your specific fob before buying.

name: Front disc thickness (base)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: base Cayman/Boxster front rotor. Minimum is also stamped on the disc hub.

name: Rear disc thickness (base)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: base rear rotor.

name: Front disc thickness (S)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: Cayman S / Boxster S front rotor (larger vented disc).

name: Rear disc thickness (S)
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: Cayman S / Boxster S rear rotor.

name: Brake pad minimum thickness
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: replace around 2-3 mm remaining; not a factory table figure.

name: Engine oil service interval
notes: MEDIUM-CONFIDENCE: factory long-life interval; databases cite up to 30,000 km/24 mo (EU). Many owners shorten to 5,000-7,500 mi given the M96/M97 durability history.
